svg.text: every component above is spliced verbatim from a gated trace; the XML comment over each one names the trace and the translate
Gold is three tiers, not one: bright bars and tabs #f5c379 / #f0bf7b, mid text cores and veneer
grain #c19867, dark outlines and strands #c5965a, over a glow family #38261a / #39281b / #3b2416 /
#351b11 that is as much ink as the gold.
haze radial cx 770 cy -120 r 1000, rotate 1.3, y scale 0.49; stops 0 and 0.35 #574568, 0.66
0. blue annulus cx 850 r 1000, y scale 0.47, #223350 0.68 to 0.84 under a left fading luminance
mask. Lit to y 300 at the centre, y 150 at the edges; black below. Drawn here translated +160 in x
PHOTO RESIDUE, do not draw: each trace lays a blurred copy of its content under the crisp content,
filter #halo blur 1.5 x 4.5 for strokes and #halotext 1.0 x 1.6 for glyphs, tagged class=photo.
That is the photograph's bloom. This sheet omits it.

0.3 body, 17 ls 1 store nav, 17 ls 1.5 hub labels, 16.5 stat labels. 700 19.5 x scale 1.6 / 1.75 boxed

500 6.5 ls 0.55 and 6.2 ls 0.7 annotations, 600 5 ls 0.78 basket micro text, 7 ls 0.4 login micro text
1 There is NO device frame. The chrome is the stacked hairline wire band: parallel strands on low
runs rising through mirrored S bends onto ONE high line. Store 8 at 3.2 pitch, bridge y 124.2; hub and
mail 8 converging to y 87; login 22 as a trapezoid across the foot. Both ends curl down into a
2 Corners are cut per widget, never by one rule: cascade card 32 top right AND bottom left; detail
panel mirrored, 42 top left; store card r13 top left, 37 degree step, r18 top right, r8 bottom right,
bottom left cut 19x22; nav and RIFLES buttons r4 / r5 with a 15x11.6 / 13x10 bottom left cut; mail
selection 22 top right; CTA 16x13 bottom left.
3 Selection is a MATERIAL: a veneer base fill plus wavy grain hairlines (mail 1.7 pitch #cf975c, SMG
2.1 #d0975a, card 2 2.4 #cd9553, basket 2.1 #c9844c), a vertical book match seam at the plate's
midpoint, arcs into the chamfer and a swirl at the leading edge.
4 Outlines come in onion layers: hub cards and the detail panel trail 6 concentric 45 degree offsets
at 3 to 3.5 pitch, 0.85 down to 0.25; store cards carry 4 echo strands at 2.5 pitch, 0.55 down to
0.18, round the step, top right, right side and bottom, dying on the bottom left cut. The SELECTED
5 Every outlined button and every list rule wears a filled trapezoid tab on its bottom edge, inside
the stroke: mail RIFLES 37/29/7 #fdcf8c, store nav 33.8/28/3.4 #f7cc8c, list rules 31/24/5, card foot
6 Boxed letters A B C D are 26x26 r3 plates with a folded bottom right corner, beside the band and in
the foot, each with a two line SPARE TIME MANAGER annotation. On the band their interior is filled
7 Dark on gold is a mid brown, never black: #3a2010 store, #5a3418 basket, #6b3f1e CTA, and #7b5438 /
#895f3b / #865c39 on the mail veneer, lighter again. Solid gold bars with a bottom left cut are the
8 Product cards name themselves at the FOOT, with a tab under the bottom edge; hub cards label at the
upper left, outside the card. The T2 badge is outlined, not filled. The message pane has no panel at
Chrome::DeviceFrame, and the module doc's 'device frame itself part of the UI': no trace has a full
screen frame. Corner::ClipTopRight { cut: 30.0 } is one global corner; every trace cuts per widget, and
nothing anywhere clips its top right by 30.
border FRAME #916424 is sampled by nothing. Outlines run #dab176 / #c5965a / #bd8951 / #e0b67a / #a97c48;
FRAME_LIT #c69a55 is the nearest const, as bar.svg records.
STRATA #634427, 'fine lines of a strata divider bunching into a wedge': no trace has one. The era's
layered fine lines are the wire band and the onion rings.
FIELD #2c1c14 vs the measured field #3c1c11; VENEER #e3af5f vs bases #f8c678 / #f4c078 / #f6c27a;
GOLD_TEXT #e7c686 vs cores #f5bf75 / #f3c583 / #e9bd7a. AMBER #fcc474 does agree with the CTA bar
ON_VENEER #3a2410 matches store gold, but the mail veneer carries #7b5438 / #895f3b, three stops lighter:
Ground::Bloom { radius 0.75 }, one BLOOM #34344c disc, vs a four stop haze plus a top left lobe plus a
blue annulus. The module doc and README cite doc #53-62 / #54-62; sources.md's canonical positions are
the title card 63 and the screens 64 to 72.
